                               Long-Term Business Plan VISION 2030

                               The Mitsui Chemicals Group has defined its ideal vision for 2030 accurately reflecting changes in the internal and external environment, based on the Corporate Vision (Corporate Mission and Corporate
                               Target) established in 1997.
                               To realize this vision, we have established a five-point Basic Strategy under our Long-Term Business Plan VISION 2030, incorporating our Corporate Vision and
                               material topics, and are advancing initiatives in line with this strategy.
                               Our foremost priority among the basic strategies is business portfolio transfor-
                               mation, which we seek to achieve by building solutions-based business models
                               and bolstering circular economy initiatives. To drive these strategies, we aim to                                               Long-Term Business Plan VISION 2030
                               achieve corporate transformation through digital transformation and accelerate
                               management and business transformation, thereby laying the bedrock for
                                                                                                                                                                          Basic Strategy
                               sustainable growth. Through the steady implementation of these five basic

                               Our Group’s M&A Activities

                               As it works toward VISION 2030, the Mitsui Chemicals Group will continue to allocate resources proactively to both organic growth and M&A opportunities that can accelerate growth. This
                               feature explains the role of M&A in the specialty chemicals domains and our initiatives to maximize investment returns—topics that have prompted many questions from investors. We also
                               present our acquisition of Meiji Seika Pharma Co., Ltd.’s agrochemicals business as a case study of how M&A has driven our business growth.

                               the L&HC and ICT domains. Specifically, we will actively pursue opportunities in fields                                                     strengthen risk management, and apply more rigorous business viability assessments.

                               Value Creation Model

                               Under our management stance aimed at enhancing corporate value, the Mitsui Chemicals Group makes the maximum use of its management capital and competitive advantages to promote three
                               corporate transformations across short-, medium-, and long-term horizons, leveraging transformation drivers to become a truly global specialty company. Looking ahead toward the corporate target and
                               ideal future society that we aspire to achieve, we will solve social challenges with the power of chemistry, contributing to a sustainable future society while achieving sustainable growth for the Group.

                               TOP ICS       InnoCell™, an innovative solution for cell culture

                                 To help solve social challenges, we launched InnoCell™, a cell culture plate, as a new solution built on our Group’s
                                 proprietary core technologies, in July 2025. InnoCell™ delivers an innovative solution for the cell culture field by combining
                                 materials, molding and processing, and biotechnologies that we have cultivated over many years.
                                    Our Group aims to create new value and expand our business domains by integrating our core technologies, and to
                                 achieve both the resolution of social challenges and sustainable growth in corporate value in specialty chemicals
                                 domains, starting with life sciences.                                                                                                            Members driving the development of InnoCell™

                               Corporate Governance for Achieving VISION 2030


                               History of corporate governance reform
                               Since the founding of Mitsui Chemicals in 1997, we have continued to implement reforms to enhance the effectiveness of our corporate governance.
                                 In fiscal 2022, we reviewed the composition of the Executive Compensation Committee and the Nomination Committee so that independent outside directors make up the majority of
                                 their members. Additionally, we appointed an independent outside director as chair of the Executive Compensation Committee, and are working to strengthen the governance over
                                 compensation and establish appropriate incentives that are aligned with VISION 2030.
                                 In fiscal 2023, we developed and began operating a Group-wide risk management system. We have been working to mitigate threats and fully capture opportunities arising from risks
                                 surrounding the Group, aiming to achieve sustainable growth and enhance corporate value over the medium- to long-term.
                                 Since fiscal 2025, the Nomination Committee has also been chaired by an independent outside director, to further enhance fairness, transparency, and objectivity relating to nominations
                                 and accelerate the advancement of our nomination system to support the achievement of VISION 2030. Additionally, we have abolished a Senior Advisor and Advisor system to further
                                 enhance the transparency and effectiveness of management.
